scripts.setup: set -eu; ROOT="${CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH:-}"; if [ "${CONDUCTOR_IS_LOCAL:-1}" = "1" ]; then export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use; fi; if [ -n "$ROOT" ] && [ -d "$ROOT" ]; then for f in client/.env client/.env.local server/.env; do [ -f "$ROOT/$f" ] && cp "$ROOT/$f" "$f"; done; fi; yarn install
